# Transcript-bootstrap calibration intervals

## Problem

Point kappa hides uncertainty, especially for small or single-class samples.

## Acceptance criteria

Report seeded 95% percentile kappa intervals per criterion and overall; pool by transcript, count undefined replicates, and never fabricate undefined estimates.

## Test plan

Known agreement cases, reproducibility, degenerate labels, sample limits and CLI JSON/markdown tests.

Milestone: v0.2.0. Local issue draft only; not filed on GitHub.
